text:
maria: Heads-up — Competitor X shipped an "adaptive routing" feature that claims better tail latency + cost. We've had 2 enterprise asks to match. Need a quick product stance: parity fast, or lean into our cost/differentiator story?

aj: Quick take: minimal parity (route tiers: low/medium/high latency pools) is doable in ~6 weeks if we avoid touching the network stack. Full parity (per-customer routing policies, UI, audit logs) is 3–4 sprints.

kevin: Design estimates align with eng. Simple UX for beta: 1 sprint for flows + 1 for polish. Full admin console is another 2 sprints.

sasha: Sales signal: two pilot customers (health and fintech) explicitly said they'd convert to Dedicated if we offer route pinning / region routing. They view this as a gating feature for migration.

owen: Revenue asks matter but also risk. We need a safe rollout plan + launch criteria. Suggest: must hit 99th pctl latency target improvement, <2% error delta on existing routes, and an automated fallback to smaller model.

maria: Proposed plan: 1) ship a "route tiers" beta in 6 weeks (API + simple UI + canary) to unblock pilots, 2) follow with a full policy engine + admin UI in Q3. Acceptance criteria will be required for beta.

aj: I can commit to the 6-week beta if we scope to existing infra (no new low-level routing fabric) and we get 2x infra engineer weeks dedicated. Also need a clear billing mapping for tiered routing.

sasha: :thumbsup: If we have an NDA + rollback plan, I'll move the pilots into beta. They also want SLA language around fallbacks.

maria: For the acceptance criteria doc I'll include: A) perf benchmark harness (seq len distribution + 99p) B) fallback policy and automated rollback C) runbook for oncall + postmortem triggers D) cost delta estimate per 10k requests. @kevin can you add mockups for the beta flow?

kevin: Mockups incoming. Quick note: beta UI will be a single checkbox + dropdown for "route tier" and an advanced link to policy. Keeps complexity minimal.

aj: dev note — sample config snippet for beta rollout:```json
{
  "routing": {
    "mode": "tiered",
    "tiers": ["low_latency", "balanced", "cost_optimized"],
    "fallback": "cost_optimized"
  },
  "canary": true
}
```

maria: Nice. Let's also add the launch metrics we will track in Console: token_cost_change, 99p_latency_by_route, error_rate_delta, rollout_success_rate.

owen: Also add a hard requirement: scriptable rollback must exist before any pilot goes to production. No shortcuts.

release-bot: deploy-bot: Canary policy flag toggled in staging at 1998724100 by aj.

sasha: One more ask from Sales: pricing language for route tiers. Product-marketing needs something simple: monthly surcharge vs usage multiplier. I'll draft language.

maria: Action items: @aj — confirm infra availability and put first PR with beta API schema by EOD Friday. @kevin — upload beta mocks. @sasha — draft pilot contract language. I'll own acceptance criteria doc and runbook.

aj: Confirmed — infra capacity approved for 6-week beta, PR scheduled.

kevin: Uploaded `/files/routing-beta-v1.png` and a quick flow in Confluence link: https://redwood.internal/confluence/routing-beta-v1

sasha: Draft pricing sent to legal. Will follow up.

maria: Great. We'll re-evaluate after the beta perf run. If the numbers look good, we move the full policy engine into Q3 planning. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
